claims.claim: subset-callers compares shipped package source only
claims.evidence: The collector and CLI corpus both exclude tests, scripts, tooling, and package-root configs. A fresh in-memory control with two equal client calls plus a smaller scripts/probe.ts call returned exactly two sites and zero findings. The committed planted control includes both tests/ and scripts/ and would fail on the old whole-corpus collector.

claims.claim: columns ignores test and tool reads/writes
claims.evidence: isColumnConsumer now admits only packages/*/src outside schema and test paths, and every read/write/raw-SQL arm uses it. A fresh in-memory script-only reader/writer left ghost as neither with empty reads/writes. The planted test includes both tests/db and scripts/seed.ts and would classify ghost read-write under the old consumer predicate.

claims.claim: clientgap uses exact client and server product buckets while tests/tools remain separately visible
claims.evidence: buildLiveness splits client src, server src, other package src, tooling, and tests before rebuilding the compatibility usedProd union. clientgap keys only on exact server minus client. The two planted controls prove a test does not acquit a server gap and db/script/package-root config imports do not enter usedServerProd; both fail under the old client-versus-everything-else split.

claims.claim: dead separates shipped-product, tool/script, and test references
claims.evidence: deadEvidenceFor partitions semantic references by packages/*/src, test paths, and the remainder, adds TOOL-ANCHORED without weakening swallowed/tagged priority, and reports tool counts/sites. The planted script-only reference was ALIVE under the old non-test predicate and is now TOOL-ANCHORED. Current pnpm ast help names the new corpus and verdict.

Field identity uses bidirectional checker assignability in every co-located native program and refuses on disagreement. A fresh old-algorithm control measured CharacterId versus TypeIdOf<"CharacterId"> at 3/7 shared (42.86%) because checker text differed; the current CLI control reports 4/6 shared (67%) and the memo-to-note rename. Current help and narration describe semanticType identity.

claims.claim: prodonly does not use Knip analysis-only roots as runtime entries
claims.evidence: Entry derivation now uses package exports, package script TypeScript targets, package-root tool configs, and the client main anchor. The inference nested-index planted control reports packages/inference/src/internal/index.ts as prod-unreachable; old knip.ts src/**/index.ts entry expansion would have made it reachable by definition.

verification.command: pnpm exec biome check <12 touched source/test files> --diagnostic-level=error
pnpm exec eslint <12 touched source/test files>

limits: No whole-corpus candidate-lens sweep was rerun in this lane. The requested serialized rot run was active at review start; after it exited, the focused behavioral suite, affected native type programs, lint, and independent in-memory boundary controls were run.
The large generated brand-boundary audit artifacts were treated as leads, not as proof of the candidate-lens behavior.
